title: Determine GPIF representations for extended barlines and numbering
scope: Map pinned AlphaTab barline and bar-number fields to actual GP3-GP8 source records, then separate supported wire variants from other-format fields.
acceptance: Inspect the upstream extended-barlines and barnumbers fixtures, including BinaryStylesheet data.
List each observed variant, its scope and the exact public/export gap, using non-default values.
Produce bounded implementation follow-ups or explicit target-limit dispositions for every reviewed variant.
exclusions: Do not implement an engraving engine.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.
